# Cookie Security Checker

> Free tool: run a CLI that sends one real request to your site, then paste the JSON here for a plain-English report on SameSite=None cookies missing Secure (which current browsers reject outright), broken __Host-/__Secure- prefix cookies, and missing Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
